summary: Full E2E verification for Slangcart ERP: (A) Vendor Add Product app-parity fields, (B) Free image picker (single + multi), (C) Device Identity per-unit, (D) create+delete round-trip for 'ZZ Test GST Product', (E) POS line reads product.gst_pct, (F) Admin Reset Center PIN gating (wrong pin → 401, no wipe), (G) Admin Manage User modal renders all controls.
